purpose: Behavioral challenge of repeated-patch homogeneity, not a sole-cause architecture claim
time: np.arange(-context,horizon), phases defined at future origin0. Context128 is exact suffix of context512 for every period; futures identical across contexts.
matching: Same generating seeds,relative phase draws,amplitudes,offset across all period/context conditions
normalization: All direct full-window MSE divided by common theoretical component energy(a*a+b*b)/2,not asserted to equal realized finite-window variance for nontiling periods
primary: TimesFM mean neighbor context benefit[0.5*(MSE128-MSE512 at31 + at33)] minus context benefit at32;positive
primary_pass: Mean>=0.05 common-theoretical-energy MSE,bootstrap95%lower>0,two-sided plus-one paired-seed signflip p<.05;negative retained
descriptive: native TimesFM forecast-change MSE across contexts
joint harmonic phase/amplitude via actual5column Gram
harmonic_measurement: OLS at forecast_start0 with targetperiod31/32/33 and other16;verifyfullrank and condition,retaincross terms in fullGram MSE+orthogonal residual;never assume diagonalGram for nontiling
homogeneity_sample: First8 generating bundles,mixed cells only;32series per period/context;capture only scalar per-series token variation,not fullcache;nativehook/nohook exactrepeat check
caveats: Frequency preference,phase-dependent normalization,spectral leakage and intrinsic difficulty vary with period. The experiment challenges one conditional mechanism,not a sole causal attribution.
selection: Frozen before new native inference;no layers,periods,models,controls,or thresholds selected from outcomes
